poll_interval.description: Interval for refreshing local system metrics.

listen_port.description: Port used for direct authenticated peer telemetry connections.

broadcast_mdns.description: Announce node presence on local subnet via mDNS.

pairing_token.description: Shared secret required for remote telemetry requests.

require_pairing_token.description: Enforce pairing token requirement. If false, token is optional (⚠️ SAFETY WARNING: Not recommended or safe on untrusted networks).

password.description: Optional secondary password required for telemetry access.
